item.title: Version 1 Expands AI Development with New Machine Learning and Generative AI Roles
item.description:
Version 1 Expands AI Development with New Machine Learning and Generative AI Roles

Version 1 is expanding its technology and transformation services by recruiting hands-on AI/ML Engineers to develop production-grade machine learning and Generative AI solutions. This development follows 30 years of business as a premier partner for global technology leaders including AWS, Microsoft, and Oracle.

🔍 Overview

Version 1 is a €350/£300m revenue business with over 3,300 employees and a 30-year history in the UK and Ireland. The company is currently seeking to integrate AI models into business systems and support the full AI development lifecycle for global brand customers.

⚙️ Key details

The development focuses on several core technical responsibilities and systems:

  • Generative AI: Developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and AI agents.
  • Application Development: Designing and maintaining AI-powered applications and services.
  • Model Integration: Integrating foundation models and APIs into enterprise applications.
  • Infrastructure: Utilizing AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes for model deployment.

🧩 Technical Scope

The expansion involves expertise across various modern AI technologies and engineering practices:

Category Technologies and Concepts
AI Services Hugging Face and major cloud service providers
Machine Learning Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering
DevOps CI/CD pipelines and containerization
Engineering LLM integration and agentic workflows

💡 Why it matters

Version 1 leverages its expertise to help customers navigate the technology landscape through partnerships with leaders such as Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, and Snowflake. The company, recognized as a Great Place to Work for over 10 years, supports its expansion through several employee initiatives:

  • Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme.
  • Mentorship coaching via Strength in Balance and Leadership schemes.
  • A dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme.
  • Flexible and remote working options to support individual circumstances.
